proscenium:
Use case: stylized-concept. ANIMOL production pixel-art game asset. Image 1 gives the approved cute clean sprite style and top-down floor camera; Image 2 gives ONLY the red-and-gold theater motif (curtains, organ pipes, gold trim), not its realistic rendering or perspective. Broad connected flat color clusters, upper-left light, crisp regular stepped curves, 1 native pixel contour. Absolutely no granular texture, random speckles, gradients, soft glow, antialiasing or blurred edges. Pixel art with an 80px base tile grid, clearly enlarged with nearest-neighbor, not painted pseudo-pixel art. Transparent background OUTSIDE the solid object. No labels or text.
Draw ONE cohesive theater proscenium architectural frame, native 240x160 pixels. Straight horizontal gold lintel across the top, two upright chunky columns, deep crimson curtains neatly tied back on left and right. A wide completely empty transparent opening in the center and bottom. Left and right curtain/column wings each occupy one 80x160 cell; the middle 80px wide span contains only a shallow horizontal lintel at top so it can be repeated to widen the theater opening. No middle keystone, no central ornament, no stage floor. Simple elegant real theater furniture, recognizable at small scale. Fabrics have just two broad folds each, restrained gold cord, no fringe tassel noise. Columns front-facing with a tiny top face like upright props in the reference game. All verticals parallel; no isometric skew or vanishing point. Palette ONLY #1A1C2C contour, #5D275D cloth shadow, #B13E53 crimson, #EF7D57 gold shadow, #FFCD75 gold highlight, #333C57 deepest structure. Whole object visible with outer transparent margins.

Draw ONE square floating theater stage foundation, native 240x240 pixels, top-down square aligned with the canvas, not a diamond or a perspective trapezoid. Entire interior is SOLID OPAQUE warm flat gold wood #FFCD75, with only a few straight wide plank joints #EF7D57: about four very broad planks and 2 staggered vertical joints total. No wood grain, knots, dotted highlights or ornamental center medallion. Thin crimson stage edging with a single restrained gold bead. At bottom/front only, a short 14 native pixel attached plum underside with one broad face and a straight gold accent at its top. Corners softly squared, radius about 6 pixels. Massive calm opaque center takes 85 percent of area. MUST NOT make any transparent hole in the center, and MUST NOT darken or fade the center. Only external margin is transparent. Palette ONLY #FFCD75 wood main, #EF7D57 plank joints/gold shadow, #B13E53 crimson edge, #5D275D underside, #333C57 bottom shadow, #1A1C2C outer contour. No sky, no props, no curtain.
organ:
Use case: stylized-concept. ANIMOL reusable game sprite. Image 1 is the approved clean cute pixel sprite style; Image 2 is a motif reference for the red velvet/gold theater. Crisp native pixel grid, hard opaque color areas, one pixel navy contour, upper-left light. Use only #1A1C2C #333C57 #5D275D #B13E53 #EF7D57 #FFCD75 #F4F4F4. No extra shades, gradients, grain, glow, dithering, dots, realistic reflections, ambient shadow outside the object or antialiasing. Render enlarged with nearest-neighbor on a fully transparent background, no floor scenery or text. Whole sprite visible with generous transparent outer margin.
ONE compact theater pipe-organ console, native160x160 pixels. Upright front-facing prop placed on a top-down floor, same projection as the small crates and lamps in Image1. Five large gold organ pipes in a simple stepped-height silhouette, central pipe tallest. Burgundy/plum wooden case with a gold rim, a tiny clearly readable black-and-white keyboard, a solid attached plinth. Enough simplicity to work on a mobile screen: no baroque filigree, no dense thin pipe forest, only two flat faces per material. Keep the case and pipes as a single connected solid sprite, preserve small intentional spaces between pipe tops. The very short top face is visible, vertical lines parallel. No stage arch or curtain.
